fusions.name: Wingbeat Fan
fusions.desc: Looses 5 curved blades in a wide spread, each dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage they deal comes back as healing over the following 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: A stripping cut that deals 18 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding their remaining damage to the hit and 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Pick the Fallen Clean
fusions.desc: Drains every body within 9.5 tiles (up to 5); each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Following Cloud
fusions.desc: A bonded swarm of locusts follows you, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
